# Load libraries

# Load data

```{r}
hpa_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
head(hpa_data)

hpa_data_v24 <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24/hpa_data_v24.csv")
head(hpa_data_v24)

tissue_data <- read_tsv("../data/HPA v.24/rna_tissue_consensus.tsv")
head(tissue_data)

uniprot_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/uniprot_v24.csv")
head(uniprot_data)
```

# Check data

```{r}
hpa_data |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, UniProt_gene = Gene, `UniProts uniprot` = UniProt, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Number of genes") 

hpa_data |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, UniProt_gene = Gene, `UniProts uniprot` = UniProt, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  # UniProt entry
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No UniProt entry",
    TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`
  )) |>
  # HPA entry
  mutate(`HPA evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "No HPA entry",
    TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
  )) %T>%
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Number of genes") 

hpa_data |> distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, UniProt_gene = Gene, `UniProts uniprot` = UniProt, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  # UniProt entry
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No UniProt entry",
    TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`
  )) |>
  # HPA entry
  mutate(`HPA evidence` = case_when(
    is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "No HPA entry",
    TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
  )) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` == "No HPA entry" | `Uniprot evidence` == "No UniProt entry") |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/hpa_uniprot_no_entry.xlsx")
```

# Plots

## Sankey: Comparing HPA and UniProt evidence

```{r}
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when (is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No evidence",
                                               TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`))  |>
  # Remove gene entries in UniProt that does not exist in HPA
  filter(Ensembl %in% hpa_data$Ensembl) |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Freq")

evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors, uniprot_colors)

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `HPA evidence`     = factor(`HPA evidence`, levels = hpa_levels),
    `Uniprot evidence` = factor(`Uniprot evidence`, levels = uniprot_levels)
  )

sankey_data_label <- sankey_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`),
    names_to = "axis",
    values_to = "stratum"
  ) %>%
  group_by(axis, stratum) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(Freq), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(stratum, "\n(", count, ")"))

ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(axis1 = `HPA evidence`,
           axis2 = `Uniprot evidence`,
           y     = Freq)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `HPA evidence`), width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5,
               color = "black"
  )  +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(
      label = after_stat(
        paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")")
      )
    ),
    size = 4,
    vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("HPA Evidence", "UniProt Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey Plot of HPA and UniProt Evidence Categories",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    fill = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3A.pdf", width = 16, height = 24, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3A.png", width = 16, height = 24, dpi = 300)
```

## Sankey: Highlighting only genes that have no UniProt evidence

```{r}
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  full_join(uniprot_data |> select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`), by = "Ensembl") |>
  mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when (is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "No human protein/transcript evidence",
                                               TRUE ~ `Uniprot evidence`)) |>
  filter(`Uniprot evidence` %in% c("No human protein/transcript evidence", "Protein uncertain (PE5)", "Protein predicted (PE4)", "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)")) |>
  filter(`HPA evidence` != "No human protein/transcript evidence") %>%
  count(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`, name = "Freq")

hpa_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"            = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level"         = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence" = "firebrick"
)
uniprot_colors <- c(
  "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)" = "#cccccc",
  "Protein predicted (PE4)"              = "#888888",
  "Protein uncertain (PE5)"              = "#444444",
  "No evidence"                          = "#111111"
)
evidence_colors <- c(hpa_colors, uniprot_colors)

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = factor(
      `Uniprot evidence`,
      levels = c(
        "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)",
        "Protein predicted (PE4)",
        "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
        "No human protein/transcript evidence" 
      )
    )
  )

total_genes <- sum(sankey_data$Freq)

ggplot(sankey_data,
       aes(
         axis1 = `Uniprot evidence`,
         axis2 = `HPA evidence`,
         y     = Freq
       )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `Uniprot evidence`),
                width = 0.4, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "black", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
    size = 4, vjust = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("UniProt", "HPA"),
    labels = c("UniProt Evidence", "HPA Evidence"),
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = evidence_colors, na.value = "#999999") +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA contributing genes v.25 (n = %d)", total_genes),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Evidence Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3B.pdf", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3B.png", width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Dataset contribution

### Venn: Protein level evidence

```{r}
hpa_contributing_proteins <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No human protein/transcript evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No human protein/transcript evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

wf    <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Western blot",
    Evidence_type == "Western blot evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

icc <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "immunocytochemistry",
    Evidence_type == "immunocytochemistry evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

ihc   <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(
    Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_proteins,
    Dataset == "Immunohistochemistry",
    Evidence_type == "Immunohistochemistry evidence"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl) %>% unique()

venn_data <- list(
  `Western blot`          = wf,
  `immunocytochemistry`    = icc,
  `Immunohistochemistry`  = ihc
)

print(length(wf))
print(length(icc))
print(length(ihc))

common_all <- Reduce(intersect, venn_data)
print(common_all)

venn_fit <- euler(venn_data)

venn_plot <- plot(
  venn_fit,
  fills      = list(
    `Western blot`         = "#75B2E9",
    `immunocytochemistry`   = "#FE625E",
    `Immunohistochemistry` = "#E8BCAD"
  ),
  quantities = TRUE,
  labels     = TRUE,
  main       = "HPA Protein‐Level Evidence Venn"
)

print(venn_plot)

ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3C.pdf",
  plot     = venn_plot, 
  width    = 8, 
  height   = 6, 
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = "../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3C.png",
  plot     = venn_plot,
  width    = 8,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = "png"
)
```

```{r}
wb_contributing <- venn_data$`Western blot` |> as.data.frame() |> rename(Ensembl = "venn_data$`Western blot`") |>
  mutate(WB = "Yes")
icc_contibuting <- venn_data$immunocytochemistry |> as.data.frame() |> rename(Ensembl = "venn_data$immunocytochemistry") |>
  mutate(ICC = "Yes")
ihc_contributing <- venn_data$Immunohistochemistry |> as.data.frame() |> rename(Ensembl = "venn_data$Immunohistochemistry") |>
  mutate(IHC = "Yes")

wb_contributing |>
  full_join(icc_contibuting, by = "Ensembl") |>
  full_join(ihc_contributing, by = "Ensembl") |> 
  mutate(
    WB = coalesce(WB, "No"),
    ICC = coalesce(ICC, "No"),
    IHC = coalesce(IHC, "No")
  ) |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene synonym`, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/venn_contributing_proteins.xlsx")
```

### Upset: Transcript level evidence

```{r}
hpa_contributing_transcripts <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No human protein/transcript evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No human protein/transcript evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level"
  ) %>%
  pull(Ensembl)

rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Immune cell type", "Cell line")

upset_base <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% rna_datasets) %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% hpa_contributing_transcripts)
  

upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, Evidence_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Evidence_type, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

set_order <- c("Tissue evidence", "Brain evidence", "Cell type evidence", "Immune cell type evidence", "Cell line evidence")
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

upset_contributing_transcripts <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Number of genes' = intersection_size(
      text = list(
        size     = 4,
        vjust    = -0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "black"
      )
    )
  ),
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4,
        color = "white",
        fontface = "bold"
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over"
)

upset_contributing_transcripts

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3D.pdf", width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3D.png", width = 14, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
upset_data |>
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, Gene, `Gene synonym`, `Gene description`, Uniprot, Chromosome), by = "Ensembl") |>
  write_xlsx("../tables/Figure 3/upset_contributing_transcripts.xlsx")
```

## Bar: Enrichment

```{r}
hpa_data_v24 %>%
  select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`, `RNA single cell type specificity`, `RNA blood cell specificity`, `RNA brain regional specificity`, `RNA cell line specificity`) |>
  filter(Ensembl %in% c(hpa_contributing_transcripts, hpa_contributing_proteins)) 
```

```{r}
# --- colors you provided
spec_colors <- c(
  "Dataset enriched"        = "#E31A1B",
  "Group enriched"          = "#FE9D00",
  "Dataset enhanced"        = "#B65EC4",
  "Low dataset specificity" = "#7D7D7D",
  "Not detected"            = "#E4E4E4",
)

# -- pick your Ensembl set
#ens_keep <- union(hpa_contributing_transcripts, hpa_contributing_proteins)

# --- helper: enforce factor order we want in the legend & stacks
spec_levels <- c("Dataset enriched", "Group enriched", "Dataset enhanced",
                 "Low dataset specificity", "Not detected")


rna_long <- hpa_data_v24 %>%
  select(
    Ensembl,
    `HPA evidence`,
    `RNA tissue specificity`,
    `RNA single cell type specificity`,
    `RNA blood cell specificity`,
    `RNA brain regional specificity`,
    `RNA cell line specificity`
  ) %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% ens_keep) %>%
  # make sure these are character (in case they arrived as factors)
  mutate(across(-Ensembl, as.character)) %>%
  # Tissue
  mutate(`RNA tissue specificity` = case_when(
    `RNA tissue specificity` == "Tissue enriched"         ~ "Dataset enriched",
    `RNA tissue specificity` == "Tissue enhanced"         ~ "Dataset enhanced",
    `RNA tissue specificity` == "Low tissue specificity"  ~ "Low dataset specificity",
    TRUE ~ `RNA tissue specificity`
  )) %>%
  # Single cell type
  mutate(`RNA single cell type specificity` = case_when(
    `RNA single cell type specificity` == "Cell type enriched"        ~ "Dataset enriched",
    `RNA single cell type specificity` == "Cell type enhanced"        ~ "Dataset enhanced",
    `RNA single cell type specificity` == "Low cell type specificity" ~ "Low dataset specificity",
    TRUE ~ `RNA single cell type specificity`
  )) %>%
  # Blood cell
  mutate(`RNA blood cell specificity` = case_when(
    `RNA blood cell specificity` == "Immune cell enriched"           ~ "Dataset enriched",
    `RNA blood cell specificity` == "Immune cell enhanced"           ~ "Dataset enhanced",
    `RNA blood cell specificity` == "Low immune cell specificity"    ~ "Low dataset specificity",
    `RNA blood cell specificity` == "Not detected in immune cells"   ~ "Not detected",
    TRUE ~ `RNA blood cell specificity`
  )) %>%
  # Brain region
  mutate(`RNA brain regional specificity` = case_when(
    `RNA brain regional specificity` == "Region enriched"        ~ "Dataset enriched",
    `RNA brain regional specificity` == "Region enhanced"        ~ "Dataset enhanced",
    `RNA brain regional specificity` == "Low region specificity" ~ "Low dataset specificity",
    TRUE ~ `RNA brain regional specificity`
  )) %>%
  # Cell line
  mutate(`RNA cell line specificity` = case_when(
    `RNA cell line specificity` == "Cancer enriched"        ~ "Dataset enriched",
    `RNA cell line specificity` == "Cancer enhanced"        ~ "Dataset enhanced",
    `RNA cell line specificity` == "Low cancer specificity" ~ "Low dataset specificity",
    TRUE ~ `RNA cell line specificity`
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`),
    names_to = "Dataset",
    values_to = "Specificity"
  )

# Optional: tidy dataset names for plotting
dataset_labels <- c(
  "RNA tissue specificity"             = "Tissue",
  "RNA single cell type specificity"   = "Single cell type",
  "RNA blood cell specificity"         = "Immune cell",
  "RNA brain regional specificity"     = "Brain region",
  "RNA cell line specificity"          = "Cell line"
)

rna_long <- rna_long %>%
  mutate(
    Dataset = recode(Dataset, !!!dataset_labels),
    # keep only our five legend categories (+ Group enriched will pass through unchanged)
    Specificity = factor(Specificity, levels = spec_levels)
  )

# 2) Count distinct Ensembl per Dataset x Specificity
counts <- rna_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(Specificity) & Specificity %in% spec_levels) %>%
  group_by(Dataset, Specificity) %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(Ensembl), .groups = "drop")

# Ensure all combinations exist (so missing categories still show as zero-height stacks)
counts <- counts %>%
  tidyr::complete(Dataset, Specificity = factor(spec_levels, levels = spec_levels), fill = list(n = 0))

# 3) Compute totals per Dataset for label
totals <- counts %>%
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

# text colors that contrast with your fills
text_colors <- c(
  "Dataset enriched"        = "white",
  "Group enriched"          = "white",
  "Dataset enhanced"        = "white",
  "Low dataset specificity" = "black",
  "Not detected"            = "black"
)

# build labels (avoid printing zeros)
counts_lbl <- counts %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(n > 0, paste0("n = ", n), ""))

p_stacked <- ggplot(counts_lbl, aes(x = Dataset, y = n, fill = Specificity)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label, color = Specificity),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.3,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spec_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = text_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of genes",
    fill = "Specificity",
    title = "RNA specificity across datasets (stacked by specificity class)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11)
  )

p_stacked

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3F new.pdf", p_stacked, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3F new.png", p_stacked, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# Plot: facets = datasets (horizontal), 2 bars per facet = the two evidence states
```

## Bars

### Tissue

```{r}
# 1. Filter to genes of interest
hpa_data_filt <- hpa_data_v24 %>%
  filter(Ensembl %in% ens_keep)

# 2. Expand the tissue/nTPM string into long format
hpa_long_filt <- hpa_data_filt %>%
  filter(!is.na(`RNA tissue specific nTPM`)) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue_value = str_split(`RNA tissue specific nTPM`, ";")
  ) %>%
  unnest(tissue_value) %>%
  mutate(
    tissue_value = str_trim(tissue_value),
    tissue = str_extract(tissue_value, "^[^:]+"),
    nTPM = as.numeric(str_extract(tissue_value, "(?<=: )\\d+\\.?\\d*"))
  )

# 3. For each Ensembl, keep only the tissue with the max nTPM
hpa_max_filt <- hpa_long_filt %>%
  group_by(Ensembl) %>%
  filter(nTPM == max(nTPM, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # in case of ties
  ungroup()

# 4. Plot
ggplot(hpa_max_filt, aes(x = tissue, fill = `HPA evidence`)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "Filtered genes: Number per tissue (by max nTPM), colored by HPA evidence",
    x = "Tissue",
    y = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Evidence at protein level" = "darkgreen",
      "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3H new.pdf", width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 3/Figure 3H new.png", width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
 hpa_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, Uniprot, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_info %>% select(Entry, `Protein existence`),
    by = c("Uniprot" = "Entry")
  ) %>%
  rename(`UniProt evidence` = `Protein existence`) %>%
  mutate(
    HPA = case_when(
      is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ `HPA evidence`
    ),
    UniProt = case_when(
      is.na(`UniProt evidence`) ~ "NA",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Inferred from homology" ~ "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Predicted" ~ "PE4: Predicted",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Uncertain" ~ "PE5: Uncertain",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" ~ "PE1: Evidence at protein level",
      `UniProt evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level" ~ "PE2: Evidence at transcript level",
      TRUE ~ `UniProt evidence`
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    UniProt %in% c(
      "PE3: Inferred from homology",
      "PE4: Predicted",
      "PE5: Uncertain",
      "NA"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(HPA != "NA") %>%

  inner_join(hpa_data |> select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`), by = "Ensembl") |>
```

```{r}
# 1) identify your “contributing” proteins
upset_base <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) 

# Make a binary wide matrix: 1 if evidence in dataset, 0 otherwise
upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, Evidence_type) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Evidence_type, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

set_order <- c("HPA: Evidence at protein level", 
               "UniProt: Evidence at protein level", 
               "HPA: Evidence at transcript level", 
               "UniProt: Evidence at transcript level", 
               "UniProt: Evidence at homology level", "
               UniProt: Proten predicted", 
               "Uniprot: Protein uncertain",
               "HPA: No human protein/transcript evidence",
               "Uniprot: No human protein/transcript evidence")

# Reverse the order for plotting
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

upset_contributing_transcripts <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over",
)

upset_contributing_transcripts
```

```{r}
# 1) Prepare a combined binary annotation dataset clearly distinguishing sources
upset_base <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`) |>
      mutate(`Uniprot evidence` = case_when(
        `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)" ~ "Protein inferred from homology",
        `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein predicted (PE4)" ~ "Protein predicted",
        `Uniprot evidence` == "Protein uncertain (PE5)" ~ "Protein uncertain",
        `Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at protein level (PE1)" ~ "Evidence at protein level",
        `Uniprot evidence` == "Experimental evidence at transcript level (PE2)" ~ "Evidence at transcript level"
      )),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `HPA evidence` = case_when(
      is.na(`HPA evidence`) ~ "HPA: No human protein/transcript evidence",
      TRUE ~ paste0("HPA: ", `HPA evidence`)
    ),
    `Uniprot evidence` = case_when(
      is.na(`Uniprot evidence`) ~ "UniProt: No human protein/transcript evidence",
      TRUE ~ paste0("UniProt: ", `Uniprot evidence`)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Ensembl, `HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`)

# 2) Pivot clearly into a wide binary matrix
upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`HPA evidence`, `Uniprot evidence`),
               names_to = "source",
               values_to = "evidence") %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, evidence) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = evidence, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

# 3) Your clearly defined column order (fixed typos)
set_order <- c(
  "HPA: Evidence at protein level",
  "UniProt: Evidence at protein level",
  "HPA: Evidence at transcript level",
  "UniProt: Evidence at transcript level",
  "UniProt: Protein inferred from homology",
  "UniProt: Protein predicted",
  "UniProt: Protein uncertain",
  "HPA: No human protein/transcript evidence",
  "UniProt: No human protein/transcript evidence"
)

# Check actual available columns (to avoid column-not-found errors)
set_order <- intersect(set_order, colnames(upset_data))

# Reverse order for ComplexUpset
set_order <- rev(set_order)

# Subset columns explicitly for ComplexUpset
upset_data <- upset_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, all_of(set_order))

# 4) Create ComplexUpset plot
upset_hpa_uniprot <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = after_stat(count)),
        stat     = "count",
        hjust    = -0.1,         # move text to the right of bars
        size     = 4,
        color    = "black",      # black color
        fontface = "bold"        # bold text
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over"
)


upset_hpa_uniprot
```

### Tissue

```{r}
sankey_data <- hpa_data %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  full_join(
    uniprot_data %>% select(Ensembl, `Uniprot evidence`),
    by = "Ensembl"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Uniprot evidence` = coalesce(`Uniprot evidence`, "No human protein/transcript evidence")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Uniprot evidence` %in% c(
      "No human protein/transcript evidence",
      "Protein uncertain (PE5)",
      "Protein predicted (PE4)",
      "Protein inferred from homology (PE3)"
    ),
    `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at protein level" | `HPA evidence` == "Evidence at transcript level"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(hpa_data_v24 |> select(Ensembl, `RNA tissue specificity`),  by = "Ensembl") |>
  count(`HPA evidence`, `RNA tissue specificity`, name = "Freq")

desired_tissue_levels <- c(
  "Tissue enriched",
  "Group enriched",
  "Tissue enhanced",
  "Low tissue specificity",
  "Not detected"
)

sankey_data <- sankey_data %>%
  mutate(
    `RNA tissue specificity` = factor(
      `RNA tissue specificity`,
      levels = desired_tissue_levels
    )
  )

hpa_evidence_colors <- c(
  "Evidence at protein level"    = "darkgreen",
  "Evidence at transcript level" = "darkorange",
  "No human protein/transcript evidence"                  = "firebrick"
)

tissue_spec_colors <- c(
  "Tissue enriched"         = "#E31A1B",
  "Group enriched"          = "#FE9D00",
  "Tissue enhanced"         = "#B65EC4",
  "Low tissue specificity"  = "#7D7D7D",
  "Not detected"            = "#E4E4E4"
)

all_colors <- c(hpa_evidence_colors, tissue_spec_colors)

p <- ggplot(
  sankey_data,
  aes(
    axis1 = `HPA evidence`,
    axis2 = `RNA tissue specificity`,
    y     = Freq
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = `HPA evidence`),
                width = 0.3, alpha = 0.8,
                color = "gray50", size = 0.2) +
  geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)),
               width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(paste0(stratum, "\n(", ..count.., ")"))),
            size = 4, vjust = 1.2) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("HPA Evidence", "RNA Tissue Specificity"),
    name   = NULL,
    expand = c(.05, .05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_colors) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("HPA evidence → RNA tissue specificity\n(n = %d genes)", sum(sankey_data$Freq)),
    y     = "Number of Genes",
    fill  = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(p)

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 3/Figure 3E.pdf", p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```
